sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Shashi Kumar Verma,Laxmi Kant Bhatt Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anand Kumar Singh Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Learned counsel for the parties are present.

In compliance of the court's order dated 06.01.2023, the court concerned has transmitted the photo copy of the compromise deed and the verification order passed thereon to this Court along with the original covering letter, wherein it has been mentioned that parties have arrived at a compromise and their compromise has been verified by the trial court.
Learned counsel for the applicants has filed supplementary affidavit along with the certified copy of the verification order passed on the compromise deed.

As the compromise between the parties has been verified by the trial court and along with its covering letter, the court has transmitted the photo copy of the compromise deed along with the photo copy of the verification order passed on its back with the joint affidavits of both the parties.
As the compromise between the parties has been verified by the trial court and the dispute between the parties is matrimonial, so the compromise between the parties shall not adversely affect the Vivek Lavi Singh And 2 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152107603/
